messages:
alex: quick async: smoke run for samplekit failed on my M1 mac when installing the node binary. doing a quick write-up below — blocking the sampleapp demo until we have a fix.

maria: ugh, thanks for flagging. which node version did you try? we recently updated quickstart to recommend Node 20 in the README.

alex: tried Node 20.1.0 via asdf, npm install fails in the native bindings step. error log attached inline:

```
> canvas@2.9.0 install /workspace/samplekit/node_modules/canvas
> node-pre-gyp install --fallback-to-build

node-pre-gyp ERR! Tried to download(403): https://example-bucket.s3/Canvas-v2.9.0-node-v108-darwin-arm64.tar.gz
node-pre-gyp ERR! Pre-built binaries not available for darwin-arm64
gyp ERR! build error
```

sam: that's the canvas native binary issue — we've seen it before on arm64. two options: pin the quickstart to Node 18 for now, or add a fallback to build from source in the CI (slower).

lee: +1 to pinning in the quickstart doc for the demo branch. we should also add a short note in the samplekit README saying "arm macs may need extra deps" and point to the troubleshooting section.

alex: filing a tiny PR to pin to 18 in the demo branch and add the note. PR: #3842. requesting an urgent review so demo isn't blocked for tomorrow's partner call.

maria: on it, I'll take the review. can you add a one-liner in docs/quickstarts/node.md and a short CI matrix change? want to keep nightly builds on Node 20 but demo runner pinned.

alex: yes, will add the matrix tweak (only run full native build on linux-hosted runners for Node 20). also adding a small FAQ section.

ci-bot: build status for branch alex/samplekit-node-pin -> FAILED on macos-arm (flake) but PASS on linux-x64. See: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/teams/devex/builds/98765

sam: minor FYI — one of the sampleapp integration tests is flakey around the auth mock. if you see an intermittent 401 in the CI logs, retry the job; we've got an issue for it: #3788.

lee: recapping actions: alex -> PR #3842 (pin + README note + CI tweak). maria -> review + approve. sam -> open follow-up to make auth mock deterministic (or we can add retry in CI). I'll update the quickstarts checklist so we don't miss this next time.

maria: reviewed and left one small comment about wording. alex, can you rebase and push? I can approve after that.

alex: rebased and pushed. pinging for review again.

maria: approved and merged. thanks. :tada:

alex: thanks all — unblocked for demo. I'll also open a short doc issue to track migrating back to Node 20 once prebuilt arm64 canvas becomes available.

sam: nice. quick heads-up: I'll do a small pass on the SDK quickstart examples later today to check for other native deps.

lee: perfect. if anything else pops up I'll post here. otherwise I'm moving this to the "quickstart follow-ups" list. :white_check_mark:
